text:
Maya (CEO): quick post-all-hands thread to capture the pipeline gaps folks raised and the follow-ups on partner GTM. thanks for the questions today.
Aria (GTM): one ask from partners: we need a clean handoff checklist so reps don't drop context. they get frustrated when they have to repeat scope.
Liam (Sales): +1. suggested minimal handoff: partner intro email, buyer problem statement, expected decision timeline, tech constraints. can we make that a CRM template?
Noor (RevOps): we can add a partner-handoff template in CRM with required fields. will make fields mandatory for stage progression to Demo.
Priya (Solutions): technical handoff should include a short integration matrix (auth, data residency, latency expectations). a 2-line tech summary saves time.
Carlos (Engineering): engineering can provide a one-paragraph "integration expectations" snippet reps can paste. will write for common stack patterns (SaaS, on-prem, VPC).
Aria (GTM): partners also asked about partner scorecards. how will we measure active partners?
Noor (RevOps): scorecard proposal: 1) leads introduced/month, 2) demo conversion rate, 3) enablement completion %, 4) revenue influence. draft spreadsheet in #revops by Thu.
Liam (Sales): for pipeline velocity, reps want a flag for "partner-blocker" so we can tag deals delayed by partner actions. helps prioritize follow-ups.
Noor (RevOps): we'll add a boolean "partner_blocker" field and a simple workflow to escalate to partner ops after 3 days.
Maya (CEO): good. leadership also wants a weekly digest of partner-impacted opps (slack thread summary). can RevOps produce a one-line daily digest?
Noor (RevOps): yes, a daily summary will post to #all-hands-partner-digest with counts and top stalled deals. starting Monday.
Priya (Solutions): enablement ask: partners want a short recorded walkthrough they can reuse in demos. 10-12 minute video showing product highlights + common integrations.
Aria (GTM): marketing can make a co-branded 10-min demo video + one-pager. Zoe (Marketing) will own but tagging here for context.
Carlos (Engineering): operational note: we're testing a partner-preview mode in Console so partners can demo limited telemetry without access to prod. staging flag in 1872509900.
DevBot: partner-preview feature flag created at 1872509900. staging deploy queued. :rocket:
Maya (CEO): excellent. last open item from Q&A: how do we treat partner-originated trials in forecasting? reps asked whether to include them in commit.
Aria (GTM): short answer: partner-originated trials go into pipeline as T0 until POC acceptance. RevOps will publish rules for forecast inclusion.
Noor (RevOps): rule: include as best-case in commit only after POC acceptance or signed LOI. will update forecast rubric.
Liam (Sales): final ask: can we run a 30m pilot next week with 3 reps + 2 partners to validate the handoff template and digest?
Aria (GTM): scheduling poll now, will post link.
Maya (CEO): action items summary: 1) CRM handoff template + partner_blocker flag (Noor) 2) integration snippets for reps (Carlos) 3) partner scorecard draft (Noor) 4) co-branded demo video + one-pager (Marketing/Aria) 5) partner-preview staging flag (Engineering) 6) forecast rules update (RevOps). I want a consolidated partner playbook draft by next Fri.
Priya (Solutions): happy to help with technical snippets.
Liam (Sales): ack.
DevBot: All-hands partner follow-up created at 1872509960 and linked in #product-docs.
